title: Home Purchase Financing Credit Policy — One Open Loan per Customer
content:
**Credit policy statement.** Hearthstone Home Finance lends only on the home a customer lives in on a Hearthstone site, so under Home Purchase Financing a customer may hold one open loan at a time — at most 1 per customer.

**The condition.** An application is taken only where the applicant has no other loan in applied, approved, active or delinquent status. A loan that is paid off, charged off, declined or withdrawn does not count.

**What decides it.** The condition is read from the loans the company's system records hold under the applicant's own customer record, as they stand before the application is taken; it is the recorded status of each of those loans that counts.

| Status of the applicant's other loan | Counts as an open loan |
|---|---|
| applied | yes |
| approved | yes |
| active | yes |
| delinquent | yes |
| paid off | no |
| charged off | no |
| declined | no |
| withdrawn | no |

*Hypothetical cases.* An applicant whose only earlier Home-Only Loan was paid off holds no open loan, and the condition is met. An applicant with an earlier application still in applied status already holds 1 open loan, so the condition is not met for a second application.
